title: The Python SDK against Cloud and Branch Connector (ZTW): where its behavior is described

prose.text: Module and method tables are generated: run `node scripts/kb.mjs surface ztw` and read the `sdk_python` entries. These subjects hold the client behavior around them; the API itself is in [[cloud-connector.api]].

prose.label: Client.
prose.text: How `client.ztw` picks OneAPI or the legacy helper is in [[cloud-connector.api.authentication]]; the legacy helper's ZTW_* settings and the logout that activates staged changes in [[cloud-connector.sdk-python.client-configuration]]; legacy retry handling in [[cloud-connector.api.rate-limits]].

prose.label: Coverage.
prose.text: Destination workload groups, workload groups and the discovery service are in [[cloud-connector.sdk-python.coverage]]; the IP pool module's missing methods and the 2.0 beta's scope in [[cloud-connector.api.client-coverage]]; the activate call in [[cloud-connector.api.activation-wire]].
